note: Full triage was done directly on the 134 new unique top-20 headlines across the 7 reachable outlets with fresh items in this window (ynet, n12, walla, kan, haaretz, themarker, i24; globes had no new unique top-20 items in this window; israelhayom/ch14/makorrishon/calcalist remained blocked from this runner per CLAUDE.md known-blocked list). This was an unusually thin day for data stories: homepages were dominated by the Oct 27 election (polls, campaign coverage), a fatal shooting attack near Hebron and the resulting military operation, and European unrest - all excluded categories (election polls / event measurements) or lacking a citable source. Only the in-scope/ambiguous/excluded subset worth flagging is itemized above; the remaining ~115 headlines (politics/campaign coverage, crime, celebrity, lifestyle, sports, weather, opinion without sourced figures) were triaged 'no' and are not itemized individually. 7 stories were selected for audit - fewer than the 12-story cap, since no genuine cross-outlet data-story clusters existed this window (the one near-cluster, the Netanyahu crypto/sanctions dispute, was excluded as a whole for lacking a citable source/figure to verify). Three of the seven selected stories (fetal-consciousness-study, lbma-gold-market-cartels-child-labor, flyandvote-airport-data-mismatch) are NYT-syndicated or paywalled pieces where only the headline/teaser was reachable (body_ok=0); they were kept in scope because the visible text still carries a specific, checkable claim, with the primary-source search and verdicting left to the audit subagent.
